title: Expressivity of Contradiction Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2605.20434v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the contradiction graphs associated with a binary concept class. For a class $H\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$, the order-$m$ contradiction graph $G_m(H)$ has as vertices the $H$-realizable labeled sequences of length $m$, with two vertices adjacent when the two sequences assign opposite labels to some common domain point. First, we identify a graph-theoretic property that determines the threshold predicate $\operatorname{VCdim}(H)\ge m$. Consequently, the sequence $(G_m(H))_{m\ge1}$ determines the exact VC dimension and, in particular, distinguishes finite from infinite VC dimension, answering a question posed by Alon et al. (2024).   We then generalize this result by proving that the sequence of contradiction graphs determines, up to signed relabeling, the realizable datasets of any fixed length. translated_abstract: 我们研究与二值概念类相关联的矛盾图。对于一个类 $H\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$，阶为 $m$ 的矛盾图 $G_m(H)$ 以可被 $H$ 实现的长度为 $m$ 的带标签序列作为顶点，当两个序列对某个共同定义域点赋予相反标签时，对应的两个顶点相邻。首先，我们识别出一个图论性质，该性质决定了阈值谓词 $\operatorname{VCdim}(H)\ge m$ 是否成立。因此，序列 $(G_m(H))_{m\ge1}$ 能够确定精确的 VC 维，特别是能够区分有限与无限的 VC 维，这回答了 Alon 等人（2024）提出的一个问题。随后，我们通过证明矛盾图序列在带符号重标记的意义下确定了任意固定长度的可实现数据集，从而推广了这一结果。因此，任何由固定长度的可实现数据集所决定、且在带符号重标记下保持不变的学习理论性质，都可以由矛盾图序列刻画。
tldr: 本文证明矛盾图序列能够精确确定概念类的VC维（可区分有限与无限VC维，回答了Alon等人2024年提出的问题），并能进一步确定任意固定长度的可实现数据集，从而刻画由这些数据集决定的学习理论性质。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the sequence of contradiction graphs determines the exact VC dimension of a binary concept class (distinguishing finite from infinite VC dimension, answering a question of Alon et al. 2024) and, up to signed relabeling, determines the realizable datasets of any fixed length, thereby capturing learning-theoretic properties determined by such datasets.
